cli_documentation:
# AQEF CLI

Install with `python -m pip install ./client`. Set `AQEF_URL` to the engine URL
and `AQEF_TOKEN` to the caller's bearer token. Use `--url` to override the URL
or `--token-file PATH` to read the token from a file. Global options work before
the resource or after the command. There is no token argument.

Each operation calls the SDK method in the table once. Each FILE is a YAML or JSON
request body. For example, `aqef project load project.yaml` sends the parsed file
directly to POST /projects. YAML may parse `version: 1.0` as a number. Quote it as
`version: "1.0"` when the API expects a string. The CLI preserves the parsed data.
Approval headers are available as `--x-approved-by` and `--x-external-review-ref`
where listed. Optional query arguments and headers are omitted unless supplied.

`aqef execution run --project demo --suite smoke --environment test --wait`
uses the engine's synchronous trigger. The initial POST waits for the finished
batch and returns its Executions, so this engine needs no polling or second request.
Use `--timeout SECONDS` to set the finite HTTP timeout, 60 seconds by default.
This bounds waiting for the engine's response. A timeout does not cancel the batch.

The default display pretty-prints returned data for reading. `--json` writes
successful response bytes directly to stdout, including an empty body for HTTP 204.
HTTP errors are written to stderr with the status and original body. The CLI
suppresses the configured bearer token if it appears in displayed output.

| Exit code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | API success. |
| 1 | A returned GateResult in a Gate check, Report, Release Decision or Execution's embedded gate evaluation has `blocking: true`, `status: fail` and no `override`. This also applies to their list responses where present. The CLI reads these fields as returned. |
| 2 | HTTP API error. |
| 3 | Transport error or timeout. |
| 64 | Usage error, including an unreadable or unparseable body file. |

An overridden Gate keeps its returned status and override identifier in JSON.
The human-readable display additionally labels it overridden.

## Not in Appendix C

- `aqef execution list` wraps `GET /projects/{project}/executions`. Execution history and filters extend C.6.
- `aqef principal create` wraps `POST /principals`. Principal provisioning is implementation-defined in C.4.
- `aqef release get` wraps `GET /projects/{project}/releases/{key}`. Direct lookup of an immutable C.3 Release Decision.
- `aqef report generate` wraps `POST /projects/{project}/reports`. Explicit freeze operation for the C.10 Report shape.
- `aqef system health` wraps `GET /healthz`. Engine health and version metadata.
- `aqef validator list` wraps `GET /projects/{project}/validators`. Local Custom Validator inventory for Volume V.
- `aqef validator register` wraps `POST /projects/{project}/validators`. Local declarative Custom Validator registration for Volume V.
appendix_c_operations: | GET | `/projects` | List all Projects the caller has access to. | `read` |
| GET | `/projects/{project}` | Retrieve Project details with Environments and Suites. | `read` |
| DELETE | `/projects/{project}` | Delete a Project and all its data. | `project_delete` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/contracts` | Create a Contract. Governed by Approval Workflow. | `contract_define` |
| PUT | `/projects/{project}/contracts/{contract}` | Replace a Contract. Governed by Approval Workflow. | `contract_define` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/datasets` | Create a Dataset (version MUST be specified). | `dataset_create` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/executions` | Trigger Execution(s) for a Suite × Environment. | `execute` |
| GET | `/projects/{project}/executions/{execution}` | Retrieve Execution status and metadata. | `read` |

| POST | `.../executions/{execution}/results/{result}/review` | Record a Human Reviewer's verdict on this Result: completes it if it is `awaiting_review`, otherwise records a new Human Reviewer Result that resolves it. | `review` |

| POST | `.../executions/{execution}/results/{result}/reassess` | Have an Oracle assess the stored Evidence again for this Result's clause, as a new Result that resolves it. The subject is not invoked. | `execute` |

| POST | `.../executions/{execution}/seeded-controls/{scenario}/invalidate` | Declare full-run invalidation for a Seeded Control missed in this Execution. Body MUST include a non-empty `reason`. | `seeded_control_invalidate` |

| POST | `.../executions/{execution}/seeded-controls/{scenario}/confirm` | Record a Human Reviewer's confirmation that the planted defect is present (or, for a clean control, that the defect class is absent) in the Evidence the Oracle received, for a control with `confirmed_by: human_reviewer` (Volume VIII). The Principal MUST be a Person. Until it is recorded, the control is `invalid` for the run. | `review` |

| POST | `/projects/{project}/requalifications` | Record that an Oracle configuration is requalified for a defect class (Volume VIII — Requalification). Body names the `oracle`, the `defect_class`, and the Seeded Control Results it rests on. MUST be rejected unless each named control is of that class, was `caught` (a defect control) or `passed` (a clean control) by that Oracle configuration, and is not a control any Oracle missed or raised a false alarm on in a run whose Results the requalification will be used to re-assess. | `execute` |

| POST | `/projects/{project}/admissions` | Record a Judge configuration's agreement with a Reference Set (Volume VI, Admission). The Principal MUST be a Person. MUST be rejected if `admitted` is `true` while `chance_corrected_agreement` is below `threshold`, or `false` while it meets it. | `review` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/snapshots` | Capture a Snapshot explicitly, for Snapshot Comparison (Volume X). | `snapshot_create` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/baselines` | Designate an Execution as Baseline. Governed by Approval Workflow. | `baseline_approve` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/gates` | Define a Quality Gate. Governed by Approval Workflow. | `contract_define` |
| PUT | `/projects/{project}/gates/{gate}` | Change a Quality Gate (threshold, `min_basis`, `on_failure`). Governed by Approval Workflow. | `contract_define` |

| POST | `/projects/{project}/gates/check` | Evaluate Gates against a set of Results. Returns one GateResult (Appendix A §A.12) per Gate and the `snapshot_id` captured for the evaluation. | `execute` |

| POST | `/projects/{project}/gates/{gate}/override` | Override one failed blocking GateResult. Body MUST name the GateResult by its `id` (Appendix A §A.12), give its `execution_batch_id`, and include a non-empty justification. Applies to that GateResult only. Governed by Approval Workflow. | `gate_override` |
| GET | `/projects/{project}/reports/{report}` | Retrieve a frozen Report, in the shape of §C.10. | `read` |

| POST | `/projects/{project}/releases` | Record a Release Decision. MUST be rejected if a Contract, Quality Gate, or Environment in its scope differs from its `snapshot_id`, or if no Quality Gate applies to its scope (Volume I, Chapter 6). Governed by Approval Workflow. | `release_decide` |
| GET | `/projects/{project}/release-policies` | List Release Policies, revoked ones included. | `read` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/release-policies` | Approve a Release Policy (Appendix A §A.14). The Principal MUST be a Person. Governed by Approval Workflow. | `release_decide` |
| POST | `/projects/{project}/release-policies/{policy}/revoke` | Revoke a Release Policy. The Principal MUST be a Person. | `release_decide` |
| GET | `/roles` | List Roles and their Permissions. | `role_read` |
| GET | `/projects/{project}/audit` | Query audit log (filtered by action type, date, actor). | `audit_read` |
| POST | `/plugins` | Register a plugin. Triggers the repeatability check for Validator Plugins (Volume XVI). | `plugin_register` |
| GET | `/plugins/{plugin}` | Retrieve plugin details and version history. | `read` |
| POST | `/plugins/{plugin}/deprecate` | Deprecate a plugin version. Historical Results remain valid. | `plugin_admin` |
